verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents ongoing monitoring of connected systems: AWS resources, GitHub configuration, user access and Dependabot alerts, Google Workspace accounts and Gmail settings, and MDM device posture. Code repositories are scanned daily and results become triageable findings. However, the evidence never states how often integration checks run, never shows failing checks being mapped to compliance controls, and never mentions alerting on failures, so the 'within hours' promise is unproven. Missing for 10: documented test cadence for cloud/SaaS integrations, explicit mapping of automated tests to control pass/fail status, alerting/notification on failing controls, independent corroboration.
